messages:
maria-sales: Heads-up, Acme sent back the PSQ. Must-haves: HSM-signed bundles (FIPS 140-2), no egress telemetry, weekly minibundles delivered via USB during the POC. They also want pricing for a 2-week onprem dedicated POC.
jon-sol-eng: Clarify signing model: do they want BYOK (their HSM) or for us to sign and provide attestations?
dina-sec: BYOK implies documented key exchange, PKCS#11 compatibility, and no remote signing unless pre-approved. We'll need specs. :warning:
harry-customer: They prefer BYOK. We use Thales Luna (PKCS#11). No network egress for signing; it can be a physical token or on-site signing appliance.
alex-ops: We support two flows: 1) customer-hosted signing appliance with offline signing step, 2) Redwood pre-signed minibundles. Flow #1 requires a signed manifest we verify.
jon-sol-eng: Example manifest fields to validate: bundle_id, components list, allowed checksums, signer id, sign_date. Installer will reject mismatches.
maria-sales: Procurement also asked for an SOW with patch cadence and hotfix SLA. Can we commit to weekly minibundles for the 2-week POC and what's the change window?
tara-legal: We can include weekly minibundles in the POC SOW. Long-term weekly cadence needs separate contract. Also add a clause about liability when customer signs artifacts on-prem.
dina-sec: Telemetry: we can build a telemetry-opt-out artifact (no outbound telemetry, logs local-only). Add ~2 business days to build + test. Need explicit PSQ acceptance criteria to prove no outbound calls.
harry-customer: Acceptance criteria: 1) Offline installer validates signature/manifest; 2) Model loads and p50 inference < 300ms on our GPU; 3) No outbound connections during install or runtime by default.
alex-ops: Packaging plan: USB-ready ZIP minibundle with runtime, model files, manifest and signature, checksum file, and an operator README. Timeline if BYOK: 48h build + 24h QA + 24h customer signing = 5 business days to first minibundle.
jon-sol-eng: Pricing ballpark: 2-week onprem reserved capacity + ops support = $15k infra + $6k eng support. Travel extra if on-site required; remote-only path cheaper if customer handles signing.
maria-sales: I'll prepare the formal quote. Need confirmed deploy timeline to sync procurement.
dina-sec: Confirmed: telemetry opt-out = +2 days; runbook/update for BYOK signing = +1 day. Earliest = 5 business days.
tara-legal: I'll draft the SOW with POC minibundle cadence, acceptance criteria, and liability language. ETA 24h.
harry-customer: Can we do HSM key rotation during the POC?
alex-ops: Recommend static signing key for POC to avoid retesting. Key rotation is a post-POC activity.
maria-sales: Action items: tara: SOW (24h), jon/alex: runbook + manifest template (48h), dina: telemetry build steps (48h), maria: quote/payment (EOD).
deploy-bot: build-job triggered by jon-sol-eng at 1768456820 - queued.
jon-sol-eng: Ill file the manifest template in the repo and kick the build once runners available.
maria-sales: Thanks team, keeping Harry in the loop. Harry, I'll follow up after SOW. :thumbsup:
